entries.title: Psalms 112:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 112:2
segments: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 112:3
segments: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:4
segments: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [He is] gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 112:5
segments: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 112:6
segments: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

entries.title: Psalms 112:7
segments: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 112:8
segments: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see [his desire] upon his adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 112:9
segments: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.

entries.title: Psalms 112:10
segments: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
